_doc: Chapter leadership as published on the legacy site. Names only — no personal phone numbers or home addresses. The legacy roster carries no date and its cross-references suggest it was last revised around 2022-23, so `asOf` is null on purpose and the page says so plainly rather than presenting a possibly-stale roster as current.
reviewRequired: The chapter must confirm the current officers, directors and committee chairs before this page goes live. Publishing a stale roster is worse than publishing none.

committees.name: Bob Tecklenburg
committees.review: The legacy site spells this “anniversity” and never says which 50th. The chapter's own 50th falls in 2035, so this is probably the Vietnam War 50th Commemoration.

notable: The chapter's ranks have run from privates to a three-star general and an admiral. Admiral Zumwalt remained a member after moving to North Carolina.
